name: Danny Exnar
bio: Danny Exnar is a Swiss-Czech actor and pianist. After studying Jazz piano in Prague and philosophy in Berne, he graduated from the acting academy Otto Falckenberg-Schule in Munich, Germany. At The Juilliard School in New York City, he trained in acting in English for his portrayal of Canadian pianist Glenn Gould for a stage production.  Danny Exnar is native in German, Czech and Swiss-German and is fluent in English and French. He appears in international productions on screen and on stage.

credits.title: A Happy Family
credits.overview: Niki has two kids, two jobs, and no money. After a fire turns her life upside down, her children are placed in foster care. Banned from contact, she assumes a new identity risking everything to stay close to them.

credits.title: Nuclear Deterrent - A Strategy for Europe
credits.overview: Until recently, Europe felt safe under the US nuclear umbrella. But since Russia invaded Ukraine and Donald Trump was re-elected, transatlantic relations have deteriorated. Experts are calling for Europe to focus more on its own nuclear deterrent. But what options do nations on the continent have?

credits.title: Maloney - Die ersten drei haarsträubenden Fälle
credits.overview: During his investigations, Philip Maloney immerses himself in different worlds and encounters greedy businesswomen, corrupt politicians, unfaithful wives / husbands and dangerous criminals.

credits.title: The Palace
credits.overview: A comedy set on New Year’s Eve 1999 in a luxurious hotel in the Swiss Alps where the lives of various guests and those who work for them intersect.

credits.title: 99 Moons
credits.overview: Everything is under control, she thinks. Everything is lost, he thinks. And then they meet. And fall.

credits.title: Caged Birds
credits.overview: Barbara Hug is a young radical lawyer fighting Switzerland's antiquated prison system in the 1980s. Walter Stürm is in and often escaping out of jail becoming known as the Jailbreak King. When the two meet an unlikely alliance is formed.
